clauses.current_legal_basis: U.S. Code release point 119-121 prints the order as amended by EO 12608 in the notes to 42 U.S.C. 2652 with no ending statement; the authority statute (Public Law 87-693, 42 U.S.C. 2651-2653) remains in the Code; no revocation, supersession or own-terms end is held.
clauses.reason: Section 1 is a continuing command to determine and establish rates from time to time. EO 12608 section 2, signed 1987-09-09 with no separate effective date, amended the order by substituting the Office of Management and Budget for the Bureau of the Budget, so the Director of the Office of Management and Budget now acts; the command itself continues. The Code note shows Section 1 in force as amended, and the 2018 OMB notice (83 FR 3368) shows the Director establishing rates under the order.

clauses.reason: Section 2 directs the Attorney General to prescribe regulations to carry out the Act of September 25, 1962 and has not been amended or ended. The Code note prints it unchanged, and the Attorney General's regulations in 28 CFR part 43 cite the order as authority (held CFR part 43 text; 75 FR 9102).

research_rationale:
EO 11060 (27 FR 10925, signed 1962-11-07) has two operative commands: Section 1 (the Budget Director sets rates for hospital, medical, surgical and dental care furnished by the United States) and Section 2 (the Attorney General prescribes regulations under the Act of September 25, 1962, Public Law 87-693, the Federal Medical Care Recovery Act). The held original, read in full, has no sunset, expiry, condition or revocation clause. The only later instrument located by the held searches is EO 12608 (signed 1987-09-09), whose section 2 lists EO 11060 among orders in which the Bureau of the Budget becomes the Office of Management and Budget; it changes the officer's title in Section 1 and leaves both commands in force. The Code (U.S. Code release point 119-121, note under 42 U.S.C. 2652) prints the order as amended by EO 12608 with the OMB Director in Section 1 and Section 2 unchanged, and the statute it implements (42 U.S.C. 2651-2653) is still printed there. Two later Federal Register documents held in the packet (75 FR 9102, 2010; 83 FR 3368, 2018) show the Attorney General and the OMB Director acting under the order. Page check: the held text of the original is the machine-read layer of the official Federal Register issue of 1962-11-09; the PDF bytes themselves are not held in the repository, so the page check rests on the text layer, which shows the order heading, the signature of John F. Kennedy dated November 7, 1962 and the filing note F.R. Doc. 62-11308, and on the 1989 OFR codification record (held) giving the citation 27 FR 10925. Cutoff: the held Code edition is current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 are not reflected in it, which is disclosed here as a limit of the held evidence.
